bib.title: Conformer: Convolution-augmented Transformer for Speech Recognition

question: How can convolution and self-attention be combined in an ASR encoder to model local and global dependencies parameter-efficiently?
hypothesis: Both global and local interactions are important for parameter efficiency, so combining self-attention and convolution in one block beats either alone.
contributions: Conformer block: macaron half-step FFN pair sandwiching MHSA (relative positional encoding) and a convolution module
State-of-the-art LibriSpeech WER at three sizes (10M, 30M, 118M)
Ablations of convolution, macaron FFN, activation, attention heads, kernel size, and conv placement

method.summary: A Conformer encoder (conv subsampling then N Conformer blocks) with a single-LSTM-layer transducer decoder is trained on LibriSpeech 960h in three sizes and compared with published ASR models, with ablations done on the large model.

datasets.name: LibriSpeech
datasets.size: 970 hours labeled speech; additional 800M word-token text-only corpus for LM
datasets.preprocessing: 80-channel filterbanks, 25ms window, 10ms stride; SpecAugment F=27, ten time masks, max time-mask ratio pS=0.05

models.name: ContextNet, Transformer Transducer, QuartzNet, LAS Transformer, LSTM, Hybrid Transformer

training.objective: inferred: transducer loss (model is called Conformer Transducer; loss not named)
training.weight_decay: l2 regularization 1e-6 on all trainable weights

inference.samples: single run per model; no seeds or variance reported

parameters.LM shallow fusion weight lambda: tuned on dev set via grid search; value not given

metrics.name: WER
metrics.definition: word error rate on LibriSpeech, results rounded to 1 decimal

eval.protocol: WER on test-clean/test-other with and without external LM; ablations on large model without LM; single run, no significance test

evidence.quote: All our evaluation results round up to 1 digit after decimal point.

limits: Only LibriSpeech (read audiobook speech); no noisy, accented or conversational evaluation.
Single runs; no seeds, variance or significance tests; WER rounded to one decimal so many ablation gaps are 0.1.
Batch size, steps, hardware, compute and LM weight lambda are not stated; no code or weights released.
Ablations run only on the large model; Table 3 and Table 5 give different single-FFN numbers.
Evaluated as full-context offline model; streaming not studied.

terms.definition: Two feed-forward modules sandwiching the multi-headed self-attention module and the convolution module, with half-step residuals and a final layernorm

lineage.note: Contemporary convolutional model at similar sizes

lineage.work: Lite Transformer with long-short range attention (Wu et al. 2020)
lineage.note: Inspiration for conv module gating and parallel-branch ablation

lineage.work: Attention is all you need (Vaswani et al. 2017)
lineage.note: Transformer blocks replaced by Conformer blocks; LR schedule
